title: An exact copy need only be possible in principle

statements.text: Building a microstate-exact copy is thermodynamically infeasible and quantum cloning is forbidden, but the theorem does not need the copy to be prepared, only that such a pair of states can exist in principle, which the no-cloning law does not prevent.

sources.quote: the theorem itself does not require the actual preparation of such states, merely that such states can exist in principle
